direct_no_normalization_comparison.method: Median original-minus-candidate fixed-slope intercept across modulations; RMS residual is computed after removing that common difference.

interpretation_limit: Candidate pre/post separation calibrates the estimator without recovering the historical noise RNG state. Treat an original preference as mapper evidence only when the measured candidate shift is close to the theoretical mapper shift and the fitted curves contain enough in-range labels. Spectral leakage, channel model differences, and shared transmissions remain possible sources of bias. A common original/direct-candidate difference does not by itself identify whether signal gain or noise scaling caused that difference.

method.label_slope: Fixed at 2 dB of estimated SNR per 1 dB label because the generator applies 10**(-label/10) to noise amplitude.
method.noise_estimator: Median out-of-band FFT-bin power divided by log(2) and the taper energy.
method.snr_estimator: Median across windows of total_power/noise_power - 1, converted to dB when positive.

normalization_model_fits.method: For each normalization model, fit one median global intercept offset across modulations and compute the RMS residual. This uses relative modulation powers, so a common channel or noise scale mismatch does not select the model.
